children: Calumet entered into a First Amendment to its DOE Loan Guarantee Agreement supporting Montana Renewables’ facility expansion in Great Falls. The amendment shifts the project to repurposing existing equipment and phased scopes, reducing the maximum guaranteed principal to $815.8 million and maximum capitalized interest to $232.8 million. It also updates advance conditions, milestones, and covenants, including lowering the Base Cash Equity Reserve threshold from $80.0 million to $20.0 million. Management expects the changes to increase capital efficiency and flexibility during construction and operations.
